name: vlsc-shopping-online
description: Root configuration to run MERN Shopping Online services simultaneously

scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,ADMIN,CUSTOMER" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client-admin start" "npm --prefix client-customer start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client-admin run build && npm --prefix client-customer run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client-admin install && npm --prefix client-customer install
